name: Blip
author: Larry & Fred
description: iMessage on Linux, as an Omarchy app. Reads and sends through a Mac you own over a multiplexed SSH socket — iMessage is macOS-only, so this machine is a thin client and the Mac is the gateway. A Messages-style window you launch from the app launcher, plus an optional bar icon: badge counts every unread; desktop toasts fire only for handles on your allowlist, because chat.db is mostly bank alerts and 2FA codes. Bar icon: left-click = panel, double-click = app, middle-click = refresh, right-click = mark all read.

barWidget.description: iMessage unread count via your Mac. Dimmed = Mac unreachable and the bridge is offline. Click for threads, history, and a compose box.
